title: Cycle capacity simulator and governance runway
creator: Lina Cho
description:
Background: Every cycle we face the same trade-off tension between ambitious roadmap goals and finite engineering capacity. Existing artifacts are static (spreadsheets, slide decks). This ticket scopes a lightweight interactive "what-if" Cycle Capacity Simulator plus an accompanying Governance Runway (decision log + approval gates) to make scope-cut decisions defensible, repeatable, and data-driven.

Goals: Produce a tool and lightweight process that lets PMs and Eng leads: (1) model multiple staffing and risk scenarios (hiring, attrition, on-call drag, holidays), (2) simulate feature readiness probabilities and downstream QA/ops work, (3) generate ranked scope-adjustment recommendations with rationale and confidence bands, and (4) capture decision history so execs can approve trimmed scopes quickly.

Scope: MVP includes backend model (Python/Colab prototype -> service API), a small React simulator UI embedded in the Console roadmap planning view, and a templated Governance Runway doc. Inputs: historical cycle velocity (by squad), planned hires and start dates, current feature-level estimates, known dependencies, on-call/maintenance burn, and risk multipliers per feature. Outputs: scenario table, per-initiative recommended scope delta (reduce, postpone, keep), expected delta to OKR deliverables, and a short decision log entry.

Key trade-offs considered: Accuracy vs productization speed — MVP will use a configurable heuristic model (weighted velocity + risk factor) rather than a full Bayesian model to keep iteration fast. Trust vs opacity — recommendations will always include the driver breakdown so humans can inspect why an item was recommended to shift. UI complexity vs adoption — keep controls minimal (3 knobs: hiring, buffer %, feature-readiness slider) to encourage use in weekly planning.

Success metrics: 1) PMs use the simulator for >=60% of cross-functional prioritization meetings for the next two cycles; 2) time-to-decision for scope cuts reduced from average 3 days to same-day for >70% of decisions; 3) forecast accuracy (delivered story points vs simulated) within +/-15% across scenarios.

Deliverables:
- Prototype simulator API and Colab model (link in comments).
- Embedded Simulator panel in Console roadmap (design spec linked).
- Governance Runway template with approval gates and decision log.
- Playbook page for PMs and Eng leads describing usage patterns and caveats.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can run three pre-defined what-if scenarios and return results within 2 minutes
Simulator output includes a ranked list of recommended scope adjustments with a short rationale for each item
Simulator panel displays inputs and driver breakdown so reviewers can trace recommendations
Governance Runway template reviewed and approved by Head of Product and Head of Engineering
Decision log entries are persisted to a shared Confluence page and linked to the corresponding Linear ticket
